patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the contents of the patch archive into the 'game' folder mentioned above, overwriting any files as prompted. It's working if: When you open the game, a warning about adult content is displayed. Additionally, the title will just be MYTH, instead of MYTH (all ages).
